prompt:
Create a complete NEW furniture sprite atlas for a sunflower-growing household in a modest Sichuan village life game. One 1536x1024 transparent RGBA sheet, 8 separated sprites in two rows of four, no labels, no floor, no scenery, no text, no characters. Background alpha exactly zero and solid opaque furniture. Do not paint a background or checkerboard.
Top row left to right: 1 octagonal honey-colored dining table with thick crossed wooden feet, a white enamel pitcher and small sunflower seed bowl; 2 straight-backed TEAL PAINTED WOODEN bench, simple slatted back and a golden yellow seat cushion, empty seat; 3 narrow cream-painted iron-frame bed with a yellow sunflower patchwork quilt, foot toward viewer; 4 tall apothecary-style seed cabinet, many small square drawers and three paper seed packets on a shelf, no legible lettering.
Bottom row: 5 compact mint-green enamel stove with small cream sink and hanging ladle, humble village kitchen; 6 sturdy box-shaped pine daybed with mustard bolsters and indigo checkered blanket; 7 a long potting-and-seed-sorting workbench with bottom drawers, two small terracotta nursery pots and folded seed envelopes; 8 freestanding simple cream cone-shade reading lamp on a slender teal metal stem and round foot.
Every item has a distinctive practical silhouette. Cohesive palette sunflower yellow, teal paint, warm pine, cream, with little indigo. No rattan, grape motifs, ornate antiques, luxury furniture or random flowers pasted onto the old shapes.
All objects share orthographic top-down oblique RPG perspective, square front faces toward viewer, visible top surfaces around 35 degrees, no diagonal isometric rotation.
ABSOLUTE STYLE REQUIREMENT: VERY COARSE TRUE PIXEL ART. Approximately 256x170 logical pixels in the entire sheet, enlarged 6x nearest-neighbor to 1536x1024. Each object only about 45-65 logical pixels across. Clearly visible LARGE SQUARE pixel clusters, bold 1-logical-pixel dark warm outlines, stair-step silhouettes, solid blocks of only 2-3 shades per material. No tiny fine texture, no painterly grain, no smooth gradients, no soft lighting, no antialiasing. Simple rich readable toy-sized sprites, not a detailed illustration with pixel filter. Keep sprites wholly apart with transparent breathing room and no spill between cells.
